description: Deploy or upgrade a Helm chart as a Dagster asset.

chart.label: Chart
chart.description: Chart reference: repository alias + name (e.g. 'my-org/ml-serving'), local path (e.g. './charts/ml-serving'), or OCI reference (e.g. 'oci://registry.example.com/charts/ml-serving').

create_namespace.label: Create Namespace
create_namespace.description: Create the namespace if it does not already exist (--create-namespace).

values_files.label: Values Files
values_files.description: List of values.yaml files passed as -f to helm upgrade.

set_values.label: Set Values
set_values.description: Key-value pairs passed as --set. Values are coerced to their YAML type by Helm.

set_string_values.label: Set String Values
set_string_values.description: Key-value pairs passed as --set-string. Values are always treated as strings.

version.label: Version
version.description: Pin a specific chart version (--version). Omit to use the latest.

repo_url.label: Repo Url
repo_url.description: Helm repository URL to add before installing (e.g. https://charts.my-company.com). Required when using a repo alias in `chart` and the repo is not already added.

repo_name.label: Repo Name
repo_name.description: Name to register the repository as (e.g. 'my-org'). Must match the alias prefix in `chart` when using a repository reference.

kube_context.label: Kube Context
kube_context.description: Kubernetes context to use (--kube-context). Uses the current context if omitted.

kubeconfig.label: Kubeconfig
kubeconfig.description: Path to a kubeconfig file (--kubeconfig). Uses ~/.kube/config if omitted.

atomic.label: Atomic
atomic.description: Roll back automatically on failure (--atomic). Ensures the release never gets stuck in a broken state.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Wait for all pods and resources to be ready before considering the deploy successful (--wait).

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for resources to become ready (--timeout). Format: '10m', '300s', etc.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Perform a dry run — render templates and validate but do not apply (--dry-run).

helm_bin.label: Helm Bin
helm_bin.description: Path to the helm binary (default: 'helm', assumed to be on PATH).

env_vars.label: Env Vars
env_vars.description: Extra environment variables for the Helm subprocess (e.g. KUBECONFIG, HELM_KUBEAPISERVER, cloud provider auth vars).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

description.label: Description
description.description: Human-readable description of what this Helm release deploys.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys this asset depends on (e.g. ['raw_orders', 'schema/orders']).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream columns it derives from, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Helm Deploy
